name: Datashaper Manager
text: This card can be Special Summoned (from your hand) by shuffling 1 'Datashaper' Spell/Trap card from your hand into the Deck. If this card is sent to the GY, you can Special Summon 2 level 4 'Datashaper' Monsters from your hand. you can only activate each effect of 'Datashaper Manager' Once per turn.
